about_the_game:
THE STORY

Planet Earth is under new management. Four of the Secret Air Command’s newest recruits, an all-girl squad of galactic fighter pilots, must convince the alien higher-ups to save the Earth from assured destruction. Their planet-hopping mission might bring them together… or tear them apart. Will this crisis spark a budding romance between the saviors of humanity or end in tragedy? Your choices decide their fate! 

Whether you’re making poor decisions with unhinged Moku, fighting to save the planet with heroic Genki, or plotting a conspiracy with cynical Kuuru, there’s something new to discover on every playthrough. Become a space pirate, solve a murder mystery, and spark a revolution along your journey to save the Earth and win the heart of your intergalactic girlfriend! You’ll have to strap in tight to your S-Wing for this roller coaster ride across the cosmos!

FEATURES

  • Nine unique endings: discover new pieces of the full story on every playthrough.

  • Thousands of expressive sprites: characters come alive with dynamic expressions and outfit changes.

  • Yuri romance: all of your squadmates are potential romantic partners!

  • A kick-ass retro OST: original music inspired by 80s jazz fusion, city pop, arena rock, and new jack swing.

  • 3D dogfights in space: first-person 3D sequences? In my visual novel?!

  • An unlockable beach episode: now that's what I call game design!

MEET THE CADETS

Mokuyoubi Yakisoba: The Perfect Leader  – an erratic gremlin with a short fuse. She was meant to be a brilliant leader, but narcissism overtook any positive aspects of her personality that may have once existed. Despite her obvious shortcomings, she knows how to have a good time. She has an affinity for doing crime, but honestly that’s the least of her problems. 

Genki Soda: The Perfect Soldier – an athletic ace pilot who will fight for her friends no matter the cost. She is the result of a cloning trial to create the ultimate super soldier. She may have a friendly and outgoing personality, but she’s naive and honest to a fault. Her burning desire to be a hero might put her in dangerous situations. 

Kuuru Biichi: The Perfect Strategist  – a macabre and analytical introvert with a strong sense of integrity. She was meant to be the ideal military strategist, complete with telepathic abilities, but she’s not very interested in the job. She used to be a target of Moku's harassment, but has developed a sharp sarcastic wit in defense.

Tuu Pureya: The Perfectly Average Human - Tuu loves her friends so much that she has developed romantic crushes on every one of them at different times. This is probably unrelated to her mommy and daddy issues. Tuu has a bright and cheery personality, despite suffering from anxiety and terminal cringe. She’s not well-suited to being a spacefaring fighter pilot, but that was never really her plan in the first place.

This game was produced without the use of generative AI.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains strong language, violence, alcohol use, drug references, references to suicide, and suggestive sexual themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or higher.
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or Direct X 11
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: In KOKORO SPACE OPERA join an all-girl squad of galactic fighter pilots as they try to save the Earth from assured destruction. Will this wacky space adventure get a happy ending? Or is this sci-fi story secretly a tragedy? Your choices decide their fate!
